description.text: The last set of the EX series, released on 14 February 2007 with 108 cards and two theme decks, Dark Blast and Mind Game. With no new Japanese set to adapt, it was made mostly in English, many of its new cards with Ken Sugimori's artwork over backgrounds taken from elsewhere, beside reprints of older cards; Japan later printed its cards in a World Champions Pack. It is loosely built around Hoenn's Elite Four, Sidney, Phoebe, Glacia and Drake, who each have a Stadium, and it holds the last Pokémon-ex and Pokémon Star of the era: Flareon, Jolteon and Vaporeon.
